Load table-level public documentation Markdown files

Source: R/docs-markdown.R
read_table_level_md.Rd

Loads the documentation stored in docs/CUH/{table_name}.md within the OMOP-ES directory omop_es_path.

Usage

read_table_level_md(table_name, omop_es_path)

Arguments

table_name

The OMOP table e.g. "condition_occurrence"

omop_es_path

Path to OMOP-ES directory

Value

Character vector of length 1 containing the Markdown file, or NULL if there is no documentation file for table_name.

Details

This is the hand-written, publishable documentation for how an OMOP table is populated. The file is returned verbatim as a single string, with lines joined by newlines, so that it can be embedded in a larger document.

See also

read_table_level_private_md() for the private counterpart, and omop_es_plugins_extract_docs_public() to load these for every mapped table.
